map.按首重、续重和体积重估算运费。: Estimate freight from first weight, additional weight and volumetric weight.
map.计费重量 = max(实际重量, 体积重量)，抛重比 = 体积重量 ÷ 实际重量: Chargeable weight = max(actual weight, volumetric weight), volumetric ratio = volumetric weight ÷ actual weight; when it exceeds 1 billing uses volumetric weight; volumetric weight (kg) = length (cm) × width (cm) × height (cm) ÷ volumetric divisor (6000 is common for road freight, 5000 for air, 8000 for express); freight = first weight fee + (chargeable weight − first weight) × additional weight unit price (a fraction of 1 kg counts as 1 kg); total cost additionally includes insured value fee and remote area surcharge.

map.寄件前按实重与体积重取大者估算运费，在多家快递之间比价。: Before shipping, estimate freight by taking the larger of actual weight and volumetric weight, then compare prices across carriers.
map.核算店铺包邮成本：把常用目的地的首重价与续重价填入，批量估算订单运费。: Work out the store's free-shipping cost: enter the first weight price and additional weight price for common destinations and batch-estimate order freight.
map.判断是否需要压缩包装——对比压缩前后的体积重，直接看运费能降多少。: Decide whether packaging needs to be compressed — compare volumetric weight before and after compression to see directly how much freight drops.
map.首重 1 kg / 首重运费 12 元 / 续重 5 元/kg。包装 30×20: First weight 1 kg / first weight freight 12 CNY / additional weight 5 CNY per kg. A 30×20×15 cm package gives volumetric weight 1.5 kg via ÷6000; actual weight 2.4 kg is larger, so the chargeable weight is 2.4 kg. Excess over first weight = 2.4 − 1 = 1.4 kg, freight = 12 + 1.4 × 5 = 19.00 CNY. Switching to a 40×30×30 cm box (volumetric weight 6.0 kg) raises the chargeable weight to 6.0 kg, freight = 12 + 5 × 5 = 37.00 CNY, nearly double.
map.常见算法是 长×宽×高(cm) ÷ 抛比，抛比国内快递多为 6000 或 800: The common formula is length × width × height (cm) ÷ volumetric divisor, where the divisor is often 6000 or 8000 for domestic express and 5000 for international express. map.为什么按体积重而不是实重计费？: Why is billing based on volumetric weight rather than actual weight?
map.轻抛货占用车厢空间但重量轻，按实重计费会让承运方亏舱位。取实重与体积重的较大值作: Light bulky goods take up carriage space but weigh little, so billing by actual weight would leave the carrier short of capacity. Taking the larger of actual and volumetric weight as the chargeable weight is standard industry practice.
